Package gui

Class EmployeeController

java.lang.Object
gui.EmployeeController
public class EmployeeController extends Object
controller for the park employee / manager home screen (EmployeeFrame.fxml).

shows the employee's name, role, and park, then provides access to:

  • Today's Reservations
  • Entry Control (check-in and exit gate)
  • Waiting List management
  • Park Reports (PARK_MANAGER only)

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      populates welcome/role/park labels and enables the Reports button only for PARK_MANAGER.

    • handleToggleTheme

      public void handleToggleTheme(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      flips the whole app between light and dark mode and updates this button's icon.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • startSessionTimer

      private void startSessionTimer()
      starts a 1-second ticker that keeps the "Session: HH:MM:SS" header label current. the window-close handler installed by startStatsAutoRefresh() stops this ticker along with the stats ticker.

    • updateSessionTimer

      private void updateSessionTimer()
      writes the current elapsed session time into the header label.

    • stopSessionTimer

      private void stopSessionTimer()
      stops and releases the session-timer ticker if it's running.

    • startStatsAutoRefresh

      private void startStatsAutoRefresh()
      starts a 30-second background ticker that re-runs loadStats() so the live stats strip stays current without a logout/login. the Timeline runs on the JavaFX application thread, and is stopped on logout, exit, or window close via stopStatsTimeline().

    • stopStatsTimeline

      private void stopStatsTimeline()
      stops and releases the stats auto-refresh ticker if it's running.

    • loadStats

      private void loadStats()
      fetches a compact live snapshot for the employee's assigned park and renders it in the stats strip: today's booking count, visitors currently inside, and the resulting capacity utilisation percentage. hides the strip if no park is assigned or the data can't be loaded.

    • hideStats

      private void hideStats()
      collapses the stats strip when there's nothing meaningful to show.

    • handleViewReports

      public void handleViewReports(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      opens Reports locked to this park. sets ReportsController.lockedParkId first so the dashboard pre-filters and disables the park filter combo-box.

    • handleParkSettings

      public void handleParkSettings(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      opens the Park Settings panel so the manager can edit capacity, max orders, visit duration, and full price for their assigned park.

    • handlePromotions

      public void handlePromotions(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      opens the Promotions panel so the manager can propose discount promotions for their assigned park. Promotions require department manager approval before they affect pricing.
